param([string]$Out, [string]$Png)
# Saves xlsx-excel-visuals.xlsx from Microsoft Excel itself (UNI-953 X02 r2):
# sheet Data (A1:C4) with a clustered column chart of A1:C4, a picture and a
# rounded rectangle with fill and text. $Png is a small PNG on disk.
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
# Excel.Application's COM class is registered to WPS on this machine, so start
# Microsoft Excel itself and take it from the running object table.
$proc = Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\EXCEL.EXE' -ArgumentList '/automation', '-Embedding' -PassThru
"excel pid $($proc.Id)"
$excel = $null
try {
  for ($t = 0; $t -lt 60 -and $null -eq $excel; $t++) {
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
    try { $excel = [Runtime.InteropServices.Marshal]::GetActiveObject('Excel.Application') } catch {}
  }
  if ($null -eq $excel) { throw 'no excel in the ROT' }
  "excel path $($excel.Path) version $($excel.Version)"
  if ($excel.Path -notlike '*Microsoft Office*') { $excel = $null; throw 'not Microsoft Excel' }
  $excel.Visible = $false
  $excel.DisplayAlerts = $false
  $wb = $excel.Workbooks.Add()
  while ($wb.Worksheets.Count -gt 1) { $wb.Worksheets.Item($wb.Worksheets.Count).Delete() }
  $ws = $wb.Worksheets.Item(1)
  $ws.Name = 'Data'
  $ws.Range('A1').Value2 = 'Region'; $ws.Range('B1').Value2 = 'Q1'; $ws.Range('C1').Value2 = 'Q2'
  $names = 'North', 'South', 'East'
  $q1 = 12.5, 9, 15.7
  $q2 = 7.8, 3, 8.6
  for ($i = 0; $i -lt 3; $i++) {
    $r = $i + 2
    $ws.Range("A$r").Value2 = [string]$names[$i]
    $ws.Range("B$r").Value2 = [double]$q1[$i]
    $ws.Range("C$r").Value2 = [double]$q2[$i]
  }
  # Chart over E2:L16 (xlColumnClustered = 51), titled.
  $at = $ws.Range('E2')
  $end = $ws.Range('L16')
  $chart = $ws.Shapes.AddChart2(201, 51, $at.Left, $at.Top, $end.Left - $at.Left, $end.Top - $at.Top).Chart
  $chart.SetSourceData($ws.Range('A1:C4'))
  $chart.HasTitle = $true
  $chart.ChartTitle.Text = 'Doanh thu'
  # Picture at A7, embedded (LinkToFile 0, SaveWithDocument -1).
  $p = $ws.Range('A7')
  $null = $ws.Shapes.AddPicture($Png, 0, -1, $p.Left, $p.Top, 96, 72)
  # Rounded rectangle (msoShapeRoundedRectangle = 5) at A14 with fill and text.
  $s = $ws.Range('A14')
  $shape = $ws.Shapes.AddShape(5, $s.Left, $s.Top, 140, 60)
  $shape.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = 0x47AD70
  $shape.TextFrame2.TextRange.Text = 'Ghi chu'
  $wb.SaveAs($Out, 51)
  $wb.Close($false)
  $excel.Quit()
} finally {
  if ($null -ne $excel) { [System.Runtime.Interopservices.Marshal]::ReleaseComObject($excel) | Out-Null }
  [GC]::Collect(); [GC]::WaitForPendingFinalizers()
  Start-Sleep -Seconds 3
  if (-not $proc.HasExited) { Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id }
}
